title: 清除浏览记录
command:
# 1. 关闭 QuickTime Player
osascript -e 'quit app "QuickTime Player"'

# 2. 删除新版 macOS 的 defaults 键
defaults delete com.apple.QuickTimePlayerX MGRecentDocumentURLBookmarks 2>/dev/null
defaults delete com.apple.QuickTimePlayerX MGRecentDocumentsSharedFileListIsValid 2>/dev/null

# 3. 老版本兜底
rm -f ~/Library/Preferences/com.apple.LSSharedFileList.ApplicationRecentDocuments/com.apple.quicktimeplayerx.sfl2 2>/dev/null

# 4. 重新打开确认
open -a "QuickTime Player"
